## 1.0.0 (2026-10-27)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Keep the GIFs Extended screen clear of the title bar ([fedfff5](https://github.com/markpaul099/gboard-gifs-extended/commit/fedfff5a134fdbcdb0045d9284b0ce24ff2b3552))

### ✨ New Features

* Add Change app name and Change package name patches ([5cd0a30](https://github.com/markpaul099/gboard-gifs-extended/commit/5cd0a30eef0574b020e0c1337628a4ee38019a05))
* Add Google Images GIF Search and GIFs Extended settings patches ([13dea9a](https://github.com/markpaul099/gboard-gifs-extended/commit/13dea9a42a89a79812338533356b144f1345342d))

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the name shown in the launcher and the keyboard list.

options.description: The name shown in the launcher and the keyboard list.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package name so the patched Gboard can be installed next to the original.

options.description: The package name of the patched app.

patches.name: GIFs Extended settings
patches.description: Adds a GIFs Extended entry to Gboard's settings with the GIF search switches.

patches.name: Google Images GIF Search
patches.description: Searches GIFs on Google Images, with Tenor as a fallback. SafeSearch can be switched in GIFs Extended settings (on by default).
